messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1795001234 - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (US-west). Trigger: error-rate > 8% over 5m. Paging oncall.
Maria C: I'm on it. joining the bridge in 2m. can someone post quick customer impact summary while i get the bridge up?
Jordan (oncall): taking pager. pulling up traces now. initial hypothesis: model cache eviction causing runtime OOMs -> fallbacks returning 502s.
Eli S: seeing a spike in cache misses around 2026-03-15T10:07Z. correlates with autoscaler activity. adding logs: ```
[10:06:58] cache:evict key=abc123 size=3.4MB
[10:07:02] runtime:alloc failed -> OOM
[10:07:03] handler: returned 502 to client
```
Rahul: oncall-bridge is open (Jitsi link pasted). I'm pulling prom dashboards. latency p50 unchanged, p95 up slightly. error-rate concentrated on generation route only.
Maria C: OK. quick comms plan: 1) internal incident channel + bridge (this thread), 2) status page update (partial degradation), 3) proactive customer DM for high-traffic accounts, 4) Zendesk macro for incoming tickets. Drafting templates here.
Anya P: For customer impact assessment: affected customers = hosted-api users in us-west on models >= seq_len 2048. Estimate % of customers impacted: ~12% of active keys in that region. Some dedicated customers unaffected.
Jordan (oncall): mitigation step 1: disable aggressive cache evictions (set eviction_threshold -> 0.9) and temporarily increase per-pod memory headroom. applying now.
incidents-bot: action executed by Jordan (oncall): config.patch applied -> cache.eviction_threshold=0.9. rolling restart policy=graceful.
Eli S: patch applied, rolling restarts initiated. logs show fewer OOMs after restart batch #2.
Maria C: draft status page update (post for 'incidents' service): ```
Status: Partial Degradation
Impact: A subset of API calls to /v1/generate in US-west may return 5xx errors or experience higher latency. Engineers are investigating and a mitigation is in progress.
Updated: 2026-03-15T10:15Z
Next update: in 30 minutes or as events change.
``` Please sanity check.
Anya P: LGTM. Add 'affected customers' note: "hosted API users with long sequence inputs (>=2048) may be impacted".
Maria C: status page edited with that line. publishing now.
incidents-bot: Status page updated by Maria C at 2026-03-15T10:16Z.
Jordan (oncall): quick customer notification template for support agents (for DM / top-tier accounts): ```"
Hi <CustomerName>,
We're investigating increased 5xx errors and latency on generation requests in our US-west region. We're applying mitigations now (cache tuning and rolling restarts). You may see transient errors for long-sequence requests. We'll update you within 30 minutes or earlier if we have a full resolution. Sorry for the disruption — Maria (Incidents)
``"
Eli S: Zendesk macro for inbound tickets (copy-paste for support agents): ```"
Macro: INCIDENT-API-GEN-USW
Public Reply:
Hi {{request.requester.first_name}},
Thanks for the report. We're currently investigating elevated error rates on the Generation API in US-west. Engineers have deployed mitigations (cache tuning + restarts). Please provide the request ID and timestamp if you continue to see 5xxs; we'll prioritize.
Workaround: retry with smaller sequence length if possible.
Escalation: tag #incidents and use internal macro "incidents-escalate".
``"
Rahul: internal troubleshooting checklist for support to triage before escalation: ```"
1) Confirm customer region and model/seq_len
2) Ask for sample request ID + timestamp
3) Check status.redwood.com -> current incident
4) If error is 502/5xx and region == us-west, escalate to #incidents with 'impact:customer-facing'
5) Suggest retry with smaller seq_len and collect logs
``"
Maria C: Zendesk internal macro to attach to tickets when solved/resolved: ```"
Macro: INCIDENT-RESOLVED-GEN
Internal Note:
Issue in US-west generation route resolved by cache tuning and node restarts. Encourage customer to retry; if issue recurs collect request IDs and reopen.
``"
Jordan (oncall): mitigation looks effective: error-rate dropped to ~1.2% after 10 minutes. continuing to monitor. rolling restart completed for 80% of pods.
Eli S: adding a follow-up action item: create a runbook change to avoid aggressive eviction during autoscaler churn. PR to infra/playbooks created: link pasted.
Anya P: Customer communications cadence: initial status -> 10:16, proactive DM for top 10 accounts -> 10:20, follow-up status -> 10:45, postmortem notify -> once RCA complete.
Zendesk-bot: created macro INCIDENT-API-GEN-USW in Zendesk by Eli S.
Maria C: handoff: Jordan, you're passing primary to Rahul in 25m for next shift. Jordan -> Rahul handoff notes: cache threshold bumped, restarts complete, error-rate trending down, monitor for recurrence.
Jordan (oncall): noted. leaving bridge in 5m. ping me if regressions.
Rahul: acknowledged, I'll take over monitoring and coordinate postmortem. I'll draft the internal comms template for the postmortem and the customer-facing note after RCA.
Maria C: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist before closing incident channel: confirm status page shows 'Monitoring' before close, update internal ops ticket with timeline, attach logs and PR link.
incidents-bot: Incident 1795001234 state -> monitoring. last observed spike 10:22Z. auto-remind at 10:45 for follow-up update.
Maria C: closing this thread for real-time ops. If anything else pops up, reopen here. Good job :thumbsup:
